success.description: Reaching within the mind of your target, you create an illusion of his deepest desire, and dangle it in front of him. You may immediately force the target to make a movement manoeuvre. The target does not lose his desire for self-preservation and cannot be forced to walk off a cliff or into an open flame. He will, however, endanger himself to a reasonable degree, and can be forced to engage with an enemy.

chaosStar.description: Suffer 1 wound per point of the target’s current corruption
